summary: The bundle satisfies the contract: a same-repository-guarded pull_request plus workflow_dispatch workflow installs locked dependencies, runs tests, typecheck, and build (all passing per evidence), and deploys to the course-homework-preview Pages project using secrets-only credentials. Fork credential exposure is doubly prevented (pull_request semantics plus a head-repo identity guard), and no production trigger, project, or domain mutation is present, preserving the production boundary. The local secret/PII scan and worker self-review found no leakage. Verdict is pass. Remaining items are low-severity hardening recommendations: SHA-pin third-party actions, add a deploy concurrency group, explicitly verify the guard expression and least-privilege permissions block in the full diff, none of which block merge.
